quotes.text: Highly misleading fees. Groww's marketing implies "zero brokerage," but that’s false for active traders. My recent statement had ₹4,466 in total charges—and a staggering ₹2,076 was pure "Groww Brokerage," plus ₹693 in DP/MIS fees. More than half the fees went directly to Groww, not the government! Their ₹20/order fee eats your profits alive. I strongly advise against using this for intraday.
